episode_event_academy2026autumn_02/8301_:
I wasn’t aware you were also a fan of this
café, Ms. Miriam.
Their pancakes are delicious, aren’t they?

Yeah, they’re quite popular! I’m so glad I
bumped into you, because they always taste
better with company!

Hehe. Chatting in a café after school...
I feel like a student again!

Studying really does work up an appetite for
something sweet.

Right?! When I was studying to become a
health teacher, I had quite the sweet tooth!

Think of this as a treat for all your hard
work. Have as much as you like today!
If you say so, Ms. Miriam, I won’t hold back.

I might even get some extra toppings for
these pancakes!

Excuse me. Could I get some ice cream,
whipped cream, butter, chocolate, honey...
Wow! Maybe I should indulge too!

Hello! Could I have some caramel, custard,
and extra Berries, please?
episode_event_academy2026autumn_02/8302_:
Look, I want to show Nurse Miriam my
appreciation, so...I need you to be my
curry studies teacher!
C-curry studies?
I’m not sure it needs its own subject, but...

I’ll teach you everything I know about curry,
Ms. Dendra!

Curry may seem basic, but it actually has a
lot of depth.
Shall we start cooking?
Osu! These vegetables go...in the pot!
W-wait! You have to peel them first!
Really? I heard their skin has nutrients...
S-sure, but putting whole vegetables in is...
I see! I need to chop them up fine!
Yaaaaaaaaa!
Ah! You diced everything?!

Ah, my eyes! These must be the tears of
youthful passion!

Ahaha... Your eyes must be affected by one
of the ingredients.

I must say, your core strength is amazing!
You were so stable—and your cuts were
so consistent!

But the ingredients are the wrong size for
the curry we’re trying to make.
S-sorry... Are they unusable?
No, we can still use them!
A diced-vegetable curry is just as delicious!

So curry studies is all about improvising.
I’m gonna learn everything I can!
episode_event_academy2026autumn_02/8303_:
So Victor, not only are you good at camping,
but you’re also a good cook.

I mean, this curry is delicious! I don’t know
much about cooking, so this is helpful.

Great! I’m not really used to training in the
mountains, so your help meant a lot too!

When I train alone, I usually only take the
bare minimum...
But equipment makes things so convenient.

Yup! You can make delicious meals that give
you energy!

I see... My meals were usually just
easy-to-carry snacks.

Once again, I learned something new.
Thank you.

You also taught me Galar karate, Bea,
so thank you too!

If you have any questions about cooking
or camping, always feel free to ask.

I will. As academy students, let’s keep
sharing knowledge—and working hard.

I was about to toast some marshmallows.
Want some?
That sounds delicious... I’d love some!
episode_event_academy2026autumn_02/8304_: So this is Paldea’s battle studies... Intriguing!

Also, having class in the schoolyard feels
nice, just like you said, Ms. Dendra!
Hahaha! It does, doesn’t it?

Actually, I’m intrigued by your Galar karate
as well!

Say, why don’t you join me and teach at
Pasio Academy?
Huh? Me, a teacher?
Yeah. You’re already a Galar Gym Leader.

I bet there are many students who’d want
to learn from you! Including me!

This academy is somewhere we can teach
and learn from each other, right?
I’m grateful for the offer...
but I’m still in training.

Also, I’m so inexperienced, simply training
myself takes all my energy.

Hmm... I don’t agree, but I respect how
you feel.
I may not be ready for it now...

but I’ll work hard to become someone who
can communicate and teach—just like you,
Ms. Dendra.
Osu! That’s good to hear!
I’ll be waiting for the day you teach a class!
Yes! I’ll work harder than ever!
Good! I won’t fall behind either!

I’m gonna learn from you—my student—
and make my battle studies lessons even
greater!
Osu!
